release.cap_rule: below the global minimum every performance job is capped at L0_descriptive regardless of point estimates (header section 6)
release.l2_l3_note: L2 needs L1 plus >= 126 post-2026-11-11 sessions under this header hash; L3 is never assignable by this harness

comparators.label: Simple participation (SPY above 200-day average, else cash)
comparators.definition: 100% SPY if SPY adjusted close(t) > its 200-session simple moving average(t) else 100% BIL; evaluated daily; executed t+1

comparators.label: Sector allocation only (top-3 sector ETFs)
comparators.definition: equal weight (1/3) in the top 3 of XLB XLC XLE XLF XLI XLK XLP XLRE XLU XLV XLY by RS63 = 63-session total return minus SPY 63-session total return; rebalance every 21 sessions

comparators.label: Member selection only (sector-neutral S&P 1500 names)
comparators.definition: S&P 1500 PIT members at t (start_date<=t<end_date or open), sector label present, >=126 valid closes, raw close>=5; score = 63-session total return minus own sector SPDR 63-session total return; per sector take top k=max(3,ceil(0.10*n_s)) equal weight; sector weights fixed = non-negative least squares style weights of SPY daily returns on the 11 SPDRs over the 252 sessions ending 2026-08-07, normalised to 1; rebalance every 21 sessions

comparators.label: Joint sector + member (top-3 sectors x top names)
comparators.definition: C3's top-3 sectors (1/3 each); within each, C4's top-k members by C4 score, equal weight; rebalance every 21 sessions

comparators.label: Incumbent Prophet book, as built
comparators.definition: index.json plans with selection_era == anticipation-v1-2026-08-08; publication session P = first session s with s > price_basis_date and s >= recorded_at; entered iff entry_zone_state.state in {filled, converted} and ledger outcome != NO_ENTRY; entry session E = first session >= max(P, filled_date if present); exit X = ledger close_date (last session <= close_date) when the plan is in the ledger, else first session after E with raw close <= invalidation or raw close >= targets[0] or date >= price_basis_date + horizon_days calendar days, else censored at window end; if X <= E the position is excluded (resolved_at_or_before_follower_fill); book = equal weight across open positions, re-equalised daily, 100% BIL when none

comparators.label: Prophet plans outside leading sectors
comparators.definition: C6 restricted to plans whose sector SPDR is NOT in C3-rule top-3 computed at the close of price_basis_date

comparators.label: Prophet plans inside leading sectors (diagnostic)
comparators.definition: C6 restricted to plans whose sector SPDR IS in that top-3 (diagnostic counterpart to C7)

comparators.label: Exposure-weight arithmetic reference only (SPY/BIL at the book's invested weight)
comparators.definition: daily weight w(t-1) in SPY and 1-w(t-1) in BIL where w is C6's risky weight at the previous close

contrasts.family: confirmatory K1-K8, Holm alpha 0.05, one-sided (a beats b)

secondary_contrasts.family: admission_class strata vs SPY, Holm alpha 0.05

exposure_matched_reference.definition: daily weight w(t-1) in SPY and 1-w(t-1) in BIL where w is C6's risky weight at the previous close

C6_exact_incumbent_prophet.linking: unlinked arithmetic sum of daily contributions; compounding residual shown

C6A_context_aligned_prophet.linking: unlinked arithmetic sum of daily contributions; compounding residual shown

limitations: Short sample: one 64-session window (SPY -4.6 pp); no rebound or crash regime was observed.
Annualised differentials from 63 daily returns are very noisy; read total-window differences and their intervals.

Population (deviation D5): 16 outage-reconstructed plans (13 receipted replays, 3 synthetic-board reconstructions) are excluded because their earliest auditable availability is after their nominal publication session; the correction was made after outcomes were seen, follows a rule that predates the evaluation, and lowers the headline.

X6 is an exposure-weight arithmetic reference, not a selection-matched comparator: it matches only risky weight, so K2 nearly repeats K1. A comparator matched on eligible cohort, concentration, sector/factor exposure, timing and costs requires a new pre-declared protocol; X6 is not replaced retrospectively.

the 2026-08-19 one-day close move of +177% (62.96 -> 174.38; raw and adjusted closes agree; volume 199,252,300) is present only in the single price cache used by this runner and is not authenticated by any second source; it affects any population that admits the replayed plans.
S&P 1500 point-in-time membership has no recorded change after 2026-06-02; 36 point-in-time members had no price file and were excluded.
Sector labels are current-basis GICS, not the classification in force at each date.

Prophet plans are read from the 2026-11-09 plan snapshot, not each plan's as-published bytes; entries use the publication clock and close-only fills, so results differ from the plan record's own same-bar outcomes.

Model book: equal weight across open positions (per position, not per distinct ticker; no same-ticker overlaps occur in this sample, so the two coincide here). It is not user holdings, a portfolio recommendation or sizing advice.
The event-study date-cluster intervals treat publication dates as independent although nearby dates share overlapping market paths, so those intervals are likely too narrow.
Issuer-excluded peer counts are unavailable: identity is the listing ticker only.
The eight catalog sleeves cannot be evaluated: plans carry no sleeve link. admission_class strata are reported instead.

deviations.what: primary population corrected to live-published plans only: 16 outage-reconstructed incumbent-era plans (13 receipted replays of the 2026-08-09 bake instantiated 2026-08-11T05:32:28Z; 3 synthetic-board reconstructions of the never-published 2026-08-11 board executed 2026-08-13T13:31:33Z) excluded from C6/C7/C6A, the all-published-plans event study, attribution, coverage counts and every contrast using them (reason not_live_origination, detected from origination_mode/backfill_executed_at and the disclosure receipts, never a hard-coded id list). Before -> after: C6 total +0.9836% -> -3.1382%; C6 vs SPY +5.6295 pp -> +1.5077 pp (CI [-9.870, +22.967] -> [-10.494, +13.386] pp); C6 positions 510 -> 498; K1 +23.6944 pp -> +6.5578 pp/yr; K2 +23.5757 pp -> +5.1173 pp/yr; K7 +41.7692 pp -> +11.7236 pp/yr; event study H=21 -2.7106 pp -> -3.0241 pp (n 430 -> 414, dates 24 -> 22). The superseded population is retained verbatim under sensitivity.superseded_as_run; sensitivity (a) admits the 13 replays only from their auditable availability and admits the synthetic-board reconstructions never.
deviations.why: the runner had treated backfilled plans as if historically published although their earliest auditable availability is their backfill receipt, after their nominal publication session (e.g. MRNA-BULL-20260616 entered at the 2026-08-10 close although instantiated 2026-08-11T05:32Z). research/PROPHET_OUTAGE_BACKFILL_2026_08.md forbids presenting reconstructed picks as live historical calls; that rule predates this evaluation. Correction made after outcomes were seen and it lowers the headline. Source: independent review REVIEW_beta_evaluation.md (sha256 6296bf4cb77d09e47f1311dbd46cd915a794e050ce7460a228ad821e7b13541a), BLOCKER finding, accepted by the programme CEO.

headline: Release level: descriptive only (L0). The window is 64 sessions; the predeclared minimum for any accepted historical claim is 252 sessions including an 8% market drawdown.
Market over the window: SPY -4.6% total return, deepest drawdown -5.9%.

Population: live-published plans only. 16 outage-reconstructed plans that no user could see on their nominal publication dates are excluded from every headline number (deviation D5); the superseded as-run numbers are retained under sensitivity.superseded_as_run.

Incumbent Prophet book (as built, 498 positions): -3.1% net, +1.5 pp versus SPY, 95% CI [-10.5, +13.4] pp. The interval includes zero: this is not evidence of outperformance, and the sample is far too short.
Beta capture: beta 0.79 (95% CI 0.63 to 1.08), mean invested weight 98%; upside capture 0.93, downside capture 0.88.
Without its largest single contributor (AMR) the book is +0.8 pp versus SPY (CI [-10.7, +12.1] pp).

Live-published plans held for a fixed 21 sessions without Prophet's exits differed from SPY by -3.0 pp on average (date-cluster CI [-5.1, -0.9] pp); most of that gap was the stock versus its own sector ETF, not the sector choice.

Sector rotation alone, sector-neutral member selection alone and their combination did not beat SPY on this window (K3 -3.9 pp/yr, K4 -3.8 pp/yr, K5 -7.6 pp/yr annualised; none significant after Holm). Insignificant results mean value is not shown, not that there is none.

The exposure-matched reference (X6) is an exposure-weight arithmetic reference only: it matches risky weight alone, and because the book is essentially fully invested, K2 nearly repeats the SPY comparison (K1) and cannot identify member-selection value.
Prophet plans inside leading sectors did better than plans outside them in this window (K7 +11.7 pp/yr annualised, Holm p 1.00); this is not significant.
Nothing here shows that sector context or member selection adds value beyond market participation.
